newsitem.title: TURKEY: "Deaths" and "many injured" in Turkish jail fire.
newsitem.headline: "Deaths" and "many injured" in Turkish jail fire.

text.p: A fire broke out at a high-security jail housing mostly Kurdish rebel prisoners on Tuesday, killing some inmates and injuring many, the Anatolian news agency said.
It said the blaze hit the prison, in the southeastern city of Diyarbakir, after inmates staged a protest at the government's failure to improve prison conditions following a recent nationwide strike.
"A fight between prisoners broke out after the protest," it said. "The incidents quickly grew when members of the security forces trying to stop the fight were attacked."
The agency did not give any figures for the casualties but said "a large number of ambulances went to the State Hospital" from the jail.
More than a dozen left-wing militant prisoners died earlier this year in a hunger strike against prison conditions.
Around 10,000 Kurdish prisoners, many linked to the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebel group, had taken part in that strike.
